=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:63, 66-68, 173-177 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The marker check runs inside the job, after the per-issue concurrency group has already cancelled an in-progress run. A trusted comment that contains "Clarification required" but is not the questions comment can therefore cancel a valid answer run, and the new gate then skips the replacement run.
  WHY: The reviewer rated this a pre-existing residual that the PR does not make worse. Only a wrapper-level `if:` change could close it, and the PR deliberately leaves the wrapper alone.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:173 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `head -n1` can exit before `printf` finishes writing a very large body, so `printf` can get SIGPIPE, and under `pipefail` the step fails.
  WHY: It needs a body near the 64 KiB pipe buffer, and GitHub caps comment bodies at 65,536 characters. The failure is fail-closed. Line 190 already uses the same pattern.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:173 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `head -n1` pipeline can cause the step to fail with SIGPIPE under `pipefail` when the comment body is large enough to exceed the pipe buffer.
  WHY: `head` closes the pipe after the first line, `printf` then gets SIGPIPE, and the shell aborts the step and marks the run failed.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:(concurrency group configuration; no line given) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The concurrency group combined with the loose `contains(github.event.comment.body, 'Clarification required')` trigger lets a non-questions trusted comment cancel an in-progress valid clarification-questions run.
  WHY: The new run hits the metadata gate and skips, so neither run completes the clarification.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  PROBLEM: A matching comment that lacks the questions marker can cancel an in-progress valid questions run for the same issue.
  WHY: `cancel-in-progress: true` cancels the first run before the second reaches its marker check and skips, which leaves the valid questions comment unanswered.
- (hardening suggestion, no severity or confidence given) .github/workflows/orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:173
  PROBLEM: The `head -n1` pipeline over the full comment body can make `printf` receive SIGPIPE under `pipefail` and fail the gate step.
  WHY: The suggested fix is Bash parameter expansion to extract the first line.
